title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook and metrics integration
author: Marco Alvarez
description: Motivation: catches prompt-set regressions earlier in CI and surfaces per-prompt metrics to help diagnose quality drops. Adds a CI hook that runs a lightweight eval-harness job on changed prompt-sets and reports per-prompt metrics to our metrics backend and PR checks. Summary of changes: 1) new GH Actions workflow .github/workflows/eval-harness-ci.yml that runs a delta check for modified prompt-sets and executes eval-harness with a small sample and baseline comparison; 2) eval-harness CLI: add --ci-hook mode to produce compact per-prompt JSON summaries and exit codes mapped to quality-gate thresholds; 3) metrics integration: a new reporter module that posts per-prompt stats to internal metrics endpoint and decorates the PR with a summary comment; 4) small docs and examples for adding prompt sets and configuring thresholds in .eval/config.yaml. Checklist: - [x] implement GH workflow and CI-level sampling - [x] add --ci-hook mode to eval-harness CLI - [x] add metrics reporter with retry/backoff - [x] tests for CLI and workflow (unit + integration smoke) - [x] update docs and README - [x] add feature flag to gate rollout Testing: unit tests for reporter and CLI; a lightweight integration run in the repo's branch-build CI that uses pinned small models and a scoped prompt-set sample; staged rollout behind feature flag eval_per_prompt_ci in CI config. Related: ENG-4123 (regression-gates), ENG-3987 (eval-harness metrics roadmap). Notes: this PR intentionally keeps sample sizes small to limit CI cost; full-suite gating will be handled by periodic nightly jobs. Release notes: adds a CI hook to detect prompt-set regressions and posts per-prompt metrics to PR. Merge: squash-merge to keep history compact.

release_notes: Adds an opt-in CI hook that runs a lightweight eval-harness on changed prompt-sets, posts per-prompt metrics to PRs, and fails CI when configured quality gates are breached.
notes: Rollout controlled by eval_per_prompt_ci feature flag; initial rollout limited to redwood/* repos. Observability: metrics tagged with repo, pr_number, prompt_set_id, and gate_name. Future work: tune thresholds per-model and integrate historical baseline service.
